notes.title: New Version 1.0.15 released
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32117907/26cee22f9708135554584e06770a51fcbfc1af5b.png
 New background
I have updated the background because many people did not like the old one. In the future I plan to create an option for it so you can choose the background yourself, should you have liked the old one better.

 New Levels
I created some new medium and large sized Levels for you. Hope you like them. More coming as soon as I find the time and energy to create them.

 Some minor Bugfixes
Some minor bugs with sound and UI were fixed. Sorry they existed. All Bugs are eradicated ASAP. Thanks to everyone who reported a bug so far. It really helps us to make a better game for you. Should you find any bug please let me know in the Community Hub. (I will look into it as soon as I can. Sometimes I am stupid an might ask you a question again, because I did not get it.)
